<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Wire tree-sitter-javascript into fs3-parsers so .js/.mjs/.cjs/.jsx files stop indexing as one bare `unknown` file element (verified live 2026-11-14: `flowspace3 search` returns dodo-gogo game/impact/lib/game/classes/branch-pool.js as kind=file, subkind=unknown). The twin of plan 015 (whose non-goals named JS/JSX as 'separate packet; tree-sitter-javascript is a different crate'). The packet is: the grammar crate and one Language::JavaScript entry, a widening of the generic value-shape rule so pre-ES6 callables (object-literal `key: function(){}` pairs, function-valued assignments `exports.x = () => {}`, JS class fields) become Function elements named by their binding, golden whole-tree fixtures with mutation receipts, the PARSER_VERSION bump, docs + add-language skill drift fix, and a real-usage receipt against a read-only copy of ~/GitHub/dodo-gogo (ImpactJS).

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- `.js`/`.mjs`/`.cjs`/`.jsx` → Language::JavaScript (one grammar; JSX lives in tree-sitter-javascript); the file element's subkind reports `javascript`
- function / generator / async function declarations, classes (declaration and named class expressions), methods (incl. getters/setters, static, private `#m`, object-literal method shorthand) become named elements with correct addresses and 1-based spans
- callables bound by value become Function elements named by their binding via the existing generic value-shape rule, widened language-agnostically: `const f = () => {}`, `let g = function(){}`, JS class-field arrows (`field_definition`), object-literal pairs (`init: function(){}`), and function-valued assignments (`exports.h = async () => {}`, `Foo.prototype.bar = function(){}` named `bar`)
- a real ImpactJS file (dodo-gogo game/impact/lib/game/main.js and peers) yields function-level elements (init/update/draw…) instead of one bare file element
- golden whole-tree fixtures + invents-nothing negatives + mutation receipts for every decision; Rust/Python/TypeScript/TSX goldens byte-unchanged

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- treating `X = Base.extend({...})` (ImpactJS/Backbone-style class factories) as Container elements — a framework call-pattern heuristic would be a per-pattern special case (o-prime ruling 3, 2026-11-14); their methods still surface as file-scoped Functions
- Flow / JSDoc type semantics, CommonJS `require` resolution, or any cross-file reference work
- routing JS through the TypeScript grammar (rejected — see key findings)
- changing ElementKind, the store schema, embeddings, discovery candidacy, or any CLI envelope
- augmented assignments (`x ||= function(){}`), destructuring patterns, computed property keys (`[k]: fn`) as elements — nameless or ambiguous, spliced through
- opening an upstream issue or the PR, or re-ingesting any live daemon — Vaughan's go via the o-prime; the live 0.7.0 daemon (:7373/:5433) is never touched

<a id="implementation-summary"></a>

## Implementation Summary

One phase, one coder. Prove tree-sitter-javascript 0.25 builds against the workspace's tree-sitter 0.26 first; wire Language::JavaScript; write sample.js/sample.jsx goldens (RED); widen the generic value-shape rule (binding kinds + value/name fields) until green, with a mutation receipt per widening; prove the four existing code goldens are untouched; bump PARSER_VERSION; update docs + skill; finish with a scratch real-usage probe over a read-only dodo-gogo copy. Expected: every JS file in dodo-gogo gains function-level elements, zero behavioural change for Rust/Python/TS/TSX fixtures.

<a id="key-findings"></a>

## Key Findings

| impact | finding | action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Critical | tree-sitter-javascript 0.25.0 is the latest crate; it depends on tree-sitter-language ^0.1 (the same ABI shim tree-sitter-typescript 0.23.2 uses under the workspace's tree-sitter 0.26), so it should link — but 015 found build resolution worth proving first. | T001 proves `cargo build -p fs3-parsers` resolves before any other work; on failure stop and report (do not bump tree-sitter). |
| High | Design call: dedicated grammar vs routing JS through tree-sitter-typescript. TS grammar mis-parses valid JS (`a &lt; b &gt; (c)` generic-call ambiguity; `&lt;T&gt;x` casts vs JSX in .js) and would make the file subkind lie (`typescript` for a .js file). | Dedicated `tree-sitter-javascript` crate, one Language::JavaScript for js\|mjs\|cjs\|jsx (JSX is in the JS grammar; no separate Jsx variant needed because there is no TS-style grammar split). |
| High | JS names its nodes differently from TS: class fields are `field_definition` with the name in `property` (TS: `public_field_definition`/`name`); object-literal pairs carry `key`/`value`; assignments carry `left`/`right`. The current rule reads only `value` and NAME_FIELDS lacks key/property/left. | Widen source.rs generically: FUNCTION_BINDINGS += field_definition, pair, assignment_expression; the value field becomes a small ordered list (value, right); naming covers key/property/left with a member_expression left resolving to its own `property` (short name, per the scanner model) and a string key unquoted. Keep `type` last in NAME_FIELDS (L3). |
| High | `pair` and `assignment_expression` also exist in tree-sitter-typescript (and Python has a dictionary `pair`), so the widening changes behaviour beyond JS. sample.ts/sample.tsx contain no function-valued pair/assignment, and Python `pair` values are never arrow/function_expression kinds — so existing goldens should be byte-unchanged; TS code in the wild gains object-literal/assignment methods (an intended, generic improvement). | AC-0004 diff check; one source.rs unit test shows the same rule firing on a .ts snippet (proves no Language branch); call the TS gain out in the PR body. |
| Medium | Classification needs no classify.rs change: function_declaration/generator_function_declaration/method_definition/class_declaration classify today; `class` (class expression) is a BARE_DECL; field_definition/lexical_declaration/variable_declaration have decl suffixes but no category hint → None; function_expression/arrow_function are not declaration-shaped. | Do not touch crates/core/src/classify.rs; a parsers-side test enumerates the JS node-kind decisions (incl. deliberate non-elements) via fs3_core::classify. |
| Medium | PARSER_VERSION bump (recipe step) + #180 means every daemon reparses every root on next boot after upgrade; enrichment is keyed by raw_hash, so only NEW JS elements cost provider calls (summaries/embeddings) on repos with JS. | Bump @4→@5 with history line; PR body names the consequence (o-prime ruling 1). |
